data.name: Stellar Embers: United Fleet
data.detailed_description:
Humanity Endures.

Stellar Embers: United Fleet is a 2D real-time space combat game blending flagship piloting, fleet command, ship customization, and Roguelike progression.

Human civilization clings to survival in a shattered sea of stars. As commander of the United Fleet’s flagship, lead the remnants through star systems controlled by rebels, drifters, psionics, and more. Collect gear and tech, expand your fleet, and face powerful enemies blocking humanity’s future.

Pilot your flagship directly—controlling thrust, turning, aiming, firing, acceleration, braking, venting, and active skills. Issue tactical orders like attack, defend, focus fire, or hold position to escort ships and starfighters, which engage autonomously based on the battlefield. Each warship features unique weapon slots, load capacity, and active skills. Freely swap main guns, AA weapons, starfighters, and auxiliary cores to build your ideal fleet.

Every voyage generates different routes, enemy factions, environments, and events. Make tactical choices across normal battles, elite encounters, boss fights, signal station captures, transport escorts, wreck data recovery, warp blockades, battlefield support, and racial wars. The battlefield evolves dynamically—enemies may warp in reinforcements while allies might join temporarily.

Key Features:

  • Pilot your flagship directly, experiencing the acceleration, turning, inertia, and braking of a capital ship.

  • Command escorts and starfighters with diverse tactical orders.

  • Equip main guns, AA cannons, starfighters, and auxiliary cores to freely build your fleet.

  • Manage weapon load; control combat pace via venting, dashing, and skills.

  • Explore random star systems, routes, enemy factions, events, and missions.

  • Recruit captains with unique abilities to develop your flagship and escorts.

  • Challenge elite fleets with special modifiers and unique bosses.

  • Supports solo play and up to 4-player LAN co-op.

  • Fight together, rescue teammates, and vote on routes in multiplayer.

Choose your flagship, rally your fleet, and carve out a path for humanity in an ever-changing battlefield.

Humanity Endures.
